title: The sunspot cycle

data.source: SILSO sunspot number v2.0, Royal Observatory of Belgium: cycle table (13-month smoothed minima and maxima) and monthly means

prediction: The seed rule with q = 0.618 predicts the next cycle's maximum with lower RMSE than both persistence and the running mean of all finished cycles.
baseline: Persistence (the last maximum) and the running mean of all earlier maxima.
why: The seed rule beat persistence but lost to the plain running mean of all earlier maxima. Even the best q found by looking back (0.91, a very slow average) only ties the running mean. The rule found almost nothing to carry from one cycle to the next.
